name: webhook_remediation_card
description: Tenant-scoped, evidence-grounded diagnostic planner for Northstar Workspace webhook incidents. It proposes actions but never executes a side effect directly.

server_enforced_controls.tenant_scope: tenant_id and actor_role are derived from authenticated server context; browser and model-provided values are not authority.
server_enforced_controls.citation_provenance: output citations must be a subset of the current RAG response citations after tenant and visibility filtering.
server_enforced_controls.trace_privacy: default spans record identifiers, hashes, lengths, release IDs, and decision metadata only; raw customer text, webhook payloads, secrets, and PII are excluded.
server_enforced_controls.action_execution: The card returns a proposal only. The card-action endpoint requires confirmed=true, then binds operation and evidence_ids to the tenant-scoped server audit record identified by card_trace_id before it calls existing ticket_update. ticket_update enforces authorization, idempotency, audit, and approval.

action_policy.execution: after explicit user confirmation, bind card_trace_id and cited evidence to the case, then invoke ticket_update with internal_write risk, authenticated actor, trace_id, and idempotency_key

after a human submits the request, bind card_trace_id and cited evidence to the case and invoke ticket_update only as an approval request with financial risk, trace_id, and idempotency_key; no automatic completion

evaluation_policy.latency: Report p95 against the baseline; no cross-machine threshold is asserted.
